news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Kaevon Merriweather joins Jaguars roster
news.desc: Kaevon Merriweather has been signed from the practice squad to the Jaguars' active roster.
news.impact: Merriweather saw in-game action for the first time this season in the Jaguars' Week 5 win over the Eagles. The veteran defensive back played in his familiar special-teams role and saw about a third of the snaps on defense with safety Eric Murray (concussion) sidelined.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Devin Neal signs with Commanders
news.desc: Devin Neal has signed with the Commanders.
news.impact: Neal will initially join Washington's practice squad to provide depth at running back. The second-year pro was released by the Vikings last week. After being selected in the sixth round of last year's NFL Draft, Neal played in 10 games for the Saints last season, rushing for over 200 yards and a couple of touchdowns on 57 carries. He also displayed pass-catching ability, securing 17 of 19 targets for 104 yards.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) to miss multiple weeks
news.desc: TreVeyon Henderson will miss multiple weeks due to a high-ankle sprain.
news.impact: Henderson left Sunday's game early and was reevaluated Monday. On a positive note, the young running back will not require surgery, but he is going to miss some games. Veteran Rhamondre Stevenson will take over as the ball carrier in Henderson's absence.

news.author: Nate Miller
news.title: Tanner Hudson (pectoral) to miss rest of the season
news.desc: Tanner Hudson (pectoral) will miss the rest of the season.
news.impact: After hauling in his first touchdown pass of the campaign in Week 5, Hudson is dealing with a torn pectoral that will force him out for the remainder of the season. Erick All Jr. saw an uptick in snaps after Hudson left Sunday's game.

news.author: Matthew Adam
news.title: Rams D/ST allows 37 points in OT loss
news.desc: The Rams D/ST allowed 37 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.impact: Los Angeles had a tough time slowing the Bills offense, especially on the ground as Buffalo racked up 234 rushing yards. The Rams did recover a James Cook fumble in overtime. The Rams will look to bounce back against the Cardinals in Week 6.

news.author: Matthew Adam
news.title: Harrison Mevis misses both of his FG attempts in Week 5
news.desc: Harrison Mevis missed both of his field-goal attempts but added four extra points in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.impact: It was a rough day for the Los Angeles kicker as Mevis had a potential game-winning field-goal attempt in overtime blocked by the Bills. Earlier in the game he misfired on a 50-yard attempt. Mevis has made just five of his nine field-goal tries this season. It wouldn't be a surprise to see the Rams try out some other options at the kicker position in the near future due to Mevis' struggles.

news.author: Matthew Adam
news.title: Tyler Higbee goes for 83 yards in Week 5
news.desc: Tyler Higbee caught five of his six targets for 83 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.impact: Higbee finished second on the Rams in receiving on Monday night, behind only Puka Nacua. The veteran tight end has earned a larger role in the team's offense thanks to some injuries in the LA tight-end room, having caught 18 passes for 212 yards and a touchdown over his past three contests. Higbee is looking like a solid fantasy option heading into Week 6 vs. Arizona.

news.author: Matthew Adam
news.title: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
news.desc: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score. Adams now has 27 catches for 441 yards and four touchdowns through five games for the Rams. He will be a solid WR2 in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.author: Matthew Adam
news.title: Puka Nacua draws 24 targets in Week 5 loss
news.desc: Puka Nacua caught 17 of his 24 targets for 138 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for nine yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.impact: Nacua drew an insane 24 targets, putting him third all-time in a single game in the NFL behind only Brandon Marshall (28) and Chris Chambers (26). The veteran wideout also found the end zone on a two-yard pass from Matthew Stafford in the fourth quarter. Nacua now has 31 catches for 337 yards and one touchdown in just three games this season. He will be a top-three fantasy WR in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.author: Matthew Adam
news.title: Blake Corum finds the end zone in Week 5
news.desc: Blake Corum carried the ball five times for 19 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his four targets for 53 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.impact: While still playing behind starter Kyren Williams, Corum turned in his most productive game of the year in the Monday night loss. He found the end zone for his first touchdown of the season on a one-yard run in the third quarter. Corum will remain a top fantasy handcuff behind Williams, but he is still just a low-end flex option in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.
